podcast.title: Convention Origins
podcast.body: The trend of FILK music originated at sci-fi conventions, where participants would play FILK songs at gatherings known as "House Filks," often performed by musicians in "FILK circles" using acoustic guitars. "The trend seems to have started at sci-fi conventions as participants would play FILK songs and gatherings called House Filks where musicians played in FILK circles, usually with acoustic guitars."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Enduring Legacy
podcast.body: FILK music has an enduring legacy, evidenced by its own dedicated awards program, the Pegasus Awards, and a FILK Hall of Fame. "FILK music is so enduring that it has its own awards program called the Pegasus Awards. And there's a FILK Hall of Fame."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Name Origin and Definition
podcast.body: FILK (F-I-L-K) rock is a genre whose name originated from a typo (I being next to O on the keyboard). It consists of folk songs specifically favored by fans of science fiction, horror movies, and fantasy. "The name itself is a typo, I is next to O on the keyboard. These were folk songs, favored by certain fans of science fiction and horror movies and fantasy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
